calculation.description: Fades a three-day price move after scaling by 15-day realized volatility. The reversal signal is amplified when the instrument's recent high-low range expands relative to its 30-day typical range and when observation-only VIX is elevated in its trailing 252-day percentile. VIX is used only as a macro conditioning input and is never traded. The signal is computed at the completed close and must be lagged one session for an online decision.

validation.regime_notes: Daily IC/ICIR: 2020-2022 0.051644/0.161115 (607 dates); 2023-2024 0.015701/0.046767 (410 dates); 2025-2027-03-24 0.035569/0.107986 (491 dates). Evidence spans multiple regimes, though the 2023-2024 subperiod was weaker. Cross-section is the available 15-asset benchmark universe; minimum 8 valid assets was used.

notes: Validation artifact generated without submitting orders. Observation-only VIX is not a tradable universe member. Library correlation remains subject to deterministic post-Miner audit.
